email.subject: Tidewater's site on mobile
email.body:
Jack,

I checked Tidewater Group Heating & Cooling's site. Two things are likely costing you calls:

It isn't set up for mobile, so when someone searches "HVAC near me" on their phone, the layout breaks and they bounce to a competitor before reading past the header. Most local searches happen on phones, so this one hits the most.

The page title also just says "Home" instead of your business name and service area, which hurts how you show up in Google results for Harbor Falls HVAC searches.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's wrong and what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
